name: PermissionsToolkit
description: Inspect user and role permissions, compare roles or users side by side, look up who has specific permissions, and scan for dangerous configurations.
author: Pharaoh2k
features: View a user's total server permissions in their popout and profile
Inspect a channel's permission overrides for every role and member
Browse permissions role by role, including each role's members
Compare two roles or two users side by side
Look up every role and member that has a specific permission
Trace where each permission comes from (role, channel override or server owner)
Security Audit for dangerous @everyone permissions, too many admin roles and risky overwrites
Filter permissions by allowed, denied or neutral, and search by name
Permissions entries in server, channel and user context menus
Localized in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian, French and Dutch
Automatic update checking with changelog display
